entries.title: Site publication linked to a canonical GitHub SHA
entries.contract: Publish only after a qualified canonical GitHub commit exists, then verify the deployed Site revision against that exact commit.
limitations: No Site publication is included in this registry tranche.

entries.title: Historical chart_navigation entry
entries.contract: Preserve durable evidence that chart_navigation existed historically without claiming a recovered current implementation.
limitations: Exact source and current implementation remain unresolved.

entries.title: Historical 70/76 entry-point mapping
entries.contract: Recover or reevaluate the historical denominator and map historical entry identities to current capabilities without automatic equivalence.
limitations: The current capability count is deliberately incomparable with 70/76 and 71/76.

entries.title: Physical OP31 goal owner
entries.contract: Provide a real runtime owner that consumes OP31 information and changes goal selection.
limitations: The OP31 calculation is available, but no physical goal owner is demonstrated.

entries.title: Common campaign snapshot and restoration
entries.contract: Persist and restore owner order, pending need, acquisition deduplication, FieldStock state, and joint-channel state across Agent activations.
limitations: Region has its own bounded snapshot, but the active common browser campaign does not yet expose a qualified cross-owner snapshot.

entries.title: Exact Site 109 and native 0.68 parity
entries.contract: Establish exact published capability and source parity with the unresolved historical Site 109/native 0.68 target.
limitations: Historical source SHA d90ce5b64fffa53cca201e2a6a49450fd123f299 remains unresolved.
